author: More Perfect Union
description:
This conservative Georgia town is fighting to shut down an ICE prison before it even opens.

The town of Social Circle, Georgia voted heavily for Trump.

But they're up in arms about a massive ICE prison, so they're shutting off the water and making the building unusable.

Producer: Trevor Hayes
Editor: @niklaak
Host: @raifeahmed
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
Videographer: Lev Omelchenko
title: This town went 74% for Trump. Now they’re blocking an ICE prison.
